item.tib: dbal phur yang snying rgyud las las mkhan bskul pa dam nyams srog gcod spu gri
item.coloph: dbal phur yang snying rgyud las/ las mkhan brgya dang rtsa brgyad kyi bsgrub pa phyi rab (rabs) kyi don du las mkhan bskul (skul) pa rgyas par mi lcogs pa'i stabs su nyung ngur bsdus pa pom ra'i gter ma'o/ dbra khyung g.yung drung bstan 'dzin dbang rgyal gsang mtshan stag chung dbal 'bar stag slag can bdag la dngos grub tu babs pa khyung nag pho brang du me lug hor zla drug pa'i tshes bcu yi nyin yar tshes bzang por gtan la phab pa'o//
